environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7 application deployed on EC2 in a public subnet with internet gateway. PostgreSQL RDS instance in same VPC with security group allowing inbound from app tier. Application runs with database user having SELECT privileges on all schemas. EC2 instance has public IP and unrestricted outbound security group rules. No WAF or API gateway in front of the service.

config.db_user_privileges: SELECT on all tables in public schema
